name: vwap_overshoot_fade_003
mechanism: On NIFTY, in moderate-VIX sessions (12-24), a 0.5% deviation from session VWAP is caused by structured retail stop-sweeps and short-horizon algo momentum triggers — not by institutional directional conviction (which would elevate VIX above 24) or by benign drift in dormant tapes (VIX below 12 where deviations are shallow and listless). When RSI(60) — a 5-minute exhaustion signal — reaches below 22 or above 78, the directional momentum engine has operated at maximum intensity for 5 full minutes without continuation: the triggering algos have exhausted their order queue. A green close bar (close > open) on the down-overshoot confirms that 5-second micro-momentum has already pivoted bullish before entry, rather than anticipating the turn — NIFTY's tight bid-ask and deep order book means a single pivot bar on the index reliably marks the order imbalance flip.
core_signal_oneliner: 0.5% VWAP deviation with 5-minute RSI at extreme (<22/>78) in moderate VIX (12-24) regime, confirmed by bullish/bearish pivot bar
